$comment: Showcase style: a neutral brand (quiet tiles, a line chart with a variance strip, a ranked dumbbell), designed as a premium finance product: solid surfaces, no glow, one radius, amber only for AC and the one highlight. Amber, navy and Inter are placeholders: put your brand here (meta.brandSlot).

meta.label: Showcase
meta.summary: Product-grade surfaces, quiet tiles, tight type, a line chart with a ΔPY% strip and a ranked dumbbell in the shared layout. Amber marks AC and the one highlight, nothing else.
meta.brandSlot: color.*.scenario.ac, color.*.scenario.pl, color.*.scenario.fc, color.*.accent.highlight, color.*.surface.page, typography.family.*

relaxes.what: Brand surfaces: a navy page in dark mode, a cool grey page with white panels in light mode.
relaxes.why: Product feel; impact and scenario colours are tuned per mode and contrast-checked.

relaxes.what: Solid panels and tiles with a hairline edge, one radius (12 px) everywhere.
relaxes.why: Chrome only; no glass, glow or gradient; chart marks carry no shade or 3D.

relaxes.what: The key message set large (20 px) in the text face; figures semibold.
relaxes.why: One bold element per page; body and labels plain with tabular figures.

relaxes.what: Faint horizontal gridlines on the line chart, values only at the line end and in the ΔPY% strip.
relaxes.why: A 12-point line reads against levels; labelling every point would crowd the hero chart.
relaxes.condition: Gridlines or full data labels on a visual, never both.

relaxes.what: One short entry fade per visual (240 ms).
relaxes.condition: Off under prefers-reduced-motion; motion never encodes data and never delays the numbers (final from the first frame, no count-up).

relaxes.what: Scenarios by hue (amber = AC, slate = PY/reference) instead of fill pattern.
relaxes.why: The line chart reads AC against one reference; hue plus labels is clearer than patterns there.
relaxes.condition: Hue separates AC from ONE reference only. Any further scenario keeps its IBCS fill (PL outlined, FC hatched or dashed), recognisable without labels; every scenario is labelled.

relaxes.what: Bars3D: pseudo-3D bars, opt-in per visual.
relaxes.why: Requested for some marketing pages; kept strictly opt-in.
relaxes.condition: Opt-in only; bar length stays linear from zero (CH 3.2: no volume comparison); never the default.

relaxes.what: A share ring is not used unless the report's owner asks for it; a Ranking is the default for structure.
relaxes.why: A ring is weak for comparison (CH 3.1); available only on explicit request.

relaxes.what: The line chart and the ranked dumbbell keep their own value scales instead of one px per unit across the page.
relaxes.why: A line is read against its labelled gridlines and a dumbbell by positions with every value printed, not by comparing lengths across charts.
relaxes.condition: Gridlines start at zero and are labelled; every dumbbell value is printed; any bars or columns of the same unit on the page share one scale.
